page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top; in the right margin two side notes ("Conclusio totius Disputationis"), set beside the first paragraph; a word "FINIS" centred below the text.

main_text.p: quæ cum Prophetarū & Apostolorum scriptis conueniunt.

Quæ cùm ita sint: cùm in disputatione Conclusio totius Disputationis. καταςκευαςικὴ sententia nostram planis ex-totius Dis- presisque Scripturæ locis cófirmauerimus: putationis. Pontificiorum autem errores ἀνασκευαστικῇ disputatione refutauerimus, atque etiā absurdis & incommodis oppresserimus, denique ad eorum obiectiones,tum ex Scriptura,tum exVeteribus propositas,respondGerimus: ita discussa erroris caligine:nobis redit ea lux veritatis, quam initiò propofuimus, in Orthodoxæ & ex verbo Dei Reformatæ ac verè Catholicæ Ecclesiæ sententia conspiciendam: nempe: Christum esse solum Pontificem ac verè sacerdotem noui Testamenti: & eius sacrificium semel in cruce peractum, esse unicum, reale & externum sacrificium in Ecclesia Christiana: idemque unicum propitiatorium pro peccatis nostris.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Side notes are partly damaged; the first note reads "Conclusio" with "totius Disputationis" below it. Greek words in the text are transcribed approximately from a worn scan; the Greek in the first line and in "ἀνασκευαστικῇ" is uncertain.
